description: Fetch one Danish public-procurement notice from udbud.dk (Denmark government tender portal) in full detail. Returns the shaped notice summary — title, buyer (ordregiver) with CVR, publication date, CPV code, notice type, estimated value in DKK, deadlines, lot count, execution place, tender documents — plus the complete notice text extracted from the official eForms rendering (English version when available). Requires the notice_id, notice_version, and publication_number exactly as returned by dk_tender_search or dk_tender_recent.

language.description: Language of the full notice text: "en" (default, machine-assisted English) or "da" (original Danish).

max_text_chars.description: Maximum characters of full notice text to return (0-30000). Default 8000. Set 0 to skip the full text and return only the summary.

notice_id.description: Notice UUID from search results, e.g. "14f9c6aa-740c-46ce-95a8-47df319d7de5".

notice_version.description: Notice version from search results, e.g. "01". Default "01".

publication_number.description: Notice publication number from search results (publication_number field), e.g. "00724546-2024".

name: dk_tender_detail
title: Dk Tender Detail
